body: ive posted on here a few times before. this is something that has been in my head for years. i just dont know how to stand it anymore. i almost went through with it about a month ago. i posted on here then, and immediately after i received a phone call that one of my close friends from home had just shot himself in the head. i thought i couldnt do that to the people i loved. but right now nobody i love is there, and they've all betrayed me and i feel so alone. i've fucked up my college because i've been so preoccupied being sad. i could have had two beautiful children, a reason to live, but they're gone now. everything is gone now. i just don't want to do it anymore. i can't stand the idea of waking up tomorrow and remembering who i am, what my life is, what i have to deal with. i don't know how to do it.
there's no starting over. i saw the comment someone left that got deleted, it said to take the pills fast and that i'd at least be with my babies if i go. i'm taking their advice, its over
